ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious PowerShell Mailbox Export to Share - PS
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of the powerShell New-MailboxExportRequest Cmdlet to exports a mailbox to a remote or local share, as used in ProxyShell exploitations Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*New\\-MailboxExportRequest.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-Mailbox\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-FilePath\\ \\\\\\\\.*"))
